story.title: Google confirms criminals used AI-built zero-day exploit in planned mass hacking campaign
story.summary: Google's Threat Intelligence Group (GTIG) has confirmed that criminal actors used an AI-generated zero-day exploit as part of a planned large-scale hacking campaign, marking a significant escalation in AI-assisted cybercrime. The report indicates AI-powered attack capabilities have moved well beyond simple phishing emails and chatbot-assisted social engineering into the creation of novel software vulnerabilities. Security experts warn the finding signals a new threat threshold that existing defensive frameworks were not designed to address.
